scenes.vo: Last week, my reflection blinked half a second after me.
scenes.cap: My reflection blinked half a second after me.

scenes.vo: I told myself I was tired. But the next day, it was one full second.
scenes.cap: The next day, it was one full second.

scenes.vo: Then it started doing things first. It smiled before I did. It turned off the light before I reached the switch.
scenes.cap: Then it started moving first. It smiled before I did.

scenes.vo: Last night, the bathroom mirror was fogged up. Someone had written one word on it. From the inside.
scenes.cap: The mirror fogged up. One word, written from the inside.

scenes.vo: This morning, I blinked, and the person in the mirror blinked first. They looked relieved.
scenes.cap: This morning, the one in the mirror blinked first. And looked relieved.

scenes.vo: Go check yours. Blink. Did it wait?
scenes.cap: Go check your mirror. Blink. Did it wait?
